items.title: CM’s promise of ₹1 crore a mirage for Sigachi blast victims’ kin in Telangana
items.text: According to the victims’ kin, the company paid ₹37 lakh in three instalments. The Central Government has paid ₹2 lakh, which several families have yet to receive, and the State Government disbursed ₹1 lakh when the bodies were handed over

items.title: 5.6 magnitude earthquake strikes Nepal’s Koshi province close to China border
items.text: The European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre (EMSC), however, put the earthquake’s magnitude at 5.3 and said it occurred at a depth of 10 kilometres

items.title: Uttar Pradesh polls: SP, Congress kick off seat-sharing talks
items.text: The meeting held at the residence of Congress Rajya Sabha MP Pramod Tiwari in New Delhi lasted just about 20 minutes, and the two sides are likely meet again November 24 to take the negotiations forward

items.title: Wall Street roars back as Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.text: Nvidia shares surged 32.2%, on track for their biggest one-day jump in more than two decades after an extraordinary reversal, which followed President Donald Trump’s call for Jensen Huang’s return

items.title: RERA approvals for two Indiramma Housing towers in Hyderabad; to help beneficiaries in getting bank loans
items.text: Telangana’s proposed Indiramma Housing towers in Malakpet and Quthbullapur receive RERA approval, enabling beneficiaries to secure bank loans for flats offered at a subsidised cost of ₹6 lakh.
